observations: Two black game consoles stacked vertically.
The front of the top console shows a PlayStation logo and a vertical seam.
The console has a matte black finish with visible scratches and scuffs on the top surface.
The console is sitting on a white plastic bag with 'McSteve' branding.
The background shows shelves with various mobile phone boxes (e.g., Samsung, Google, OnePlus).
No controllers, cables, or game discs are visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: The seller's location is Abuja, Nigeria, but the console is not shown with a UK-specific label or power adapter.
The console design, including the vertical seam and logo, is characteristic of the PS4 Pro model.
No controller or pad is visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty optical drive.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and the disc drive reading a game.

risks.risk: The controller may be missing, broken, or have a stick drift.
risks.proof: A photo of the controller and a video of it being used.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the console's serial number and the 'PSN Status'.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powering on and navigating the home screen.
Photo of the controller and any cables.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the model number and PSN status.
Photo of the original game discs or digital codes.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
